name: Your final challenge waits in the Nether

pages.text: The Hovering Inferno is the pack’s endgame boss. Reaching the Nether or defeating the Ender Dragon does not mean your equipment is ready for this encounter.$(br2)Prepare your strongest practical loadout, reliable food, protection, charged equipment and spare supplies. Know how your armor and modules behave before asking them to carry you through the fight.
